channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Boban Marjanovic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Boban Marjanovic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Boban Marjanovic
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“Well, I mean, it just depends on what they’re good at. If you have a specific unique skill that adds value to our team, then there’s a chance we’re going to be interested in you. Now you may not play 30 minutes a game you may be situation might be like Boban [Marjanovic] is very situational, right? You can’t play him every game, but when he plays it because the matchup is good, and he can be impactful.”

Mark Cuban on Boban Marjanovic, Apr 24, 2021. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Boban Marjanovic
item.description:
“Especially because they basically tease each other most of the time. They go back and forth. We were just laughing all night. “I even told (Marjanović), ‘Bobi, I know what you’re gonna do after the career. You’re gonna work on TV, for sure.’”

Goran Dragic on Boban Marjanovic, Sep 11, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Boban Marjanovic
item.description:
Suns rookie center Deandre Ayton on his first matchup against Clippers 7-3 center Boban Marjanovic:

“He's freakishly big. That's my first time playing against someone that can just take the ball above my head and just not jump. I had an experience of a lifetime.”

Deandre Ayton on Boban Marjanovic, Dec 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @BA_Turner.

item.title: Sasha Djordjevic on Milos Teodosic, Boban Marjanovic, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Sasa Djordjevic on Milos Teodosic, Boban Marjanovic and Nikola Jokic not playing for Serbia:

“As the windows pile up, the less of us there are. I was optimistic in front of this window, when I put up the preliminary list, hoping the big names will be here, that they’ll receive permission from their clubs, that they won’t have any problems. But, unfortunately, some cancelled, some had to listen to their club’s opinion.”

Sasha Djordjevic on Milos Teodosic, Boban Marjanovic, Nikola Jokic, Sep 2, 2018. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Michael Malone on Boban Marjanovic
item.description:
#Nuggets coachMichael Malone on Boban Marjanovic, who keyed the Clippers' big comeback against Denver in their last meeting:

“You can't teach his size, his sheer physicality. He is an immense human being who's very skilled...we have to make him defend on the other end.”

Michael Malone on Boban Marjanovic, Apr 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.
